cards.title: Add a page title to your homepage
cards.explanation: Your homepage does not have a page title, the line search engines show as the headline of your listing.
cards.why_it_matters: Without a title, search results guess what to show, and people may not see what you do or where.
cards.recommended_action: Write a title of about 50–60 characters that names your main service, followed by sunrise-plumbing.example.
cards.expected_benefit: People searching can tell what your page offers before they click.

cards.title: Give your homepage a clear main headline
cards.explanation: Your homepage has no main heading that says what you do.
cards.why_it_matters: Visitors decide in seconds whether you can help them. A clear headline answers that right away.
cards.recommended_action: Add a headline at the top that names your main service.
cards.expected_benefit: Visitors understand what you offer as soon as the page opens.

cards.title: Make your homepage fit phone screens
cards.explanation: Your homepage is missing the setting that tells phones to size the page to the screen.
cards.why_it_matters: Without it, phones show a shrunken desktop page that is hard to read and tap.
cards.recommended_action: Ask your web designer to add the standard mobile viewport tag, or switch to a mobile-friendly theme.
cards.expected_benefit: Phone visitors can read and tap your page without zooming.

cards.title: Add a short description for search results
cards.explanation: Your homepage has no meta description, the short summary search engines may show under your title.
cards.why_it_matters: Without one, search engines pick random text from the page, which may not explain why someone should choose you.
cards.recommended_action: Write one or two sentences (about 150 characters) that say what you offer, who it's for, and how to get in touch.
cards.expected_benefit: A summary in search results that you chose, instead of a random sentence.

cards.title: Let phone visitors call you with one tap
cards.explanation: Your phone number is shown as plain text, so people on phones have to copy it to call.
cards.why_it_matters: Most local visitors browse on phones. Making it easy to call removes a step between interest and a conversation.
cards.recommended_action: Add your phone number near the top of the homepage as a tap-to-call link (a “tel:” link), and repeat it near the bottom.
cards.expected_benefit: Fewer steps for a visitor who wants to call you.

cards.title: Explain your services in a few more words
cards.explanation: Your homepage has about 9 words, which may not be enough to explain what you offer.
cards.why_it_matters: Visitors and search engines both need a few clear sentences to understand your services and who they are for.
cards.recommended_action: Add a short section that lists your main services, who they help, and where you work.
cards.expected_benefit: Visitors get enough information to decide to contact you.

cards.title: Describe your images
cards.explanation: 1 images on your site have no text description.
cards.why_it_matters: Descriptions help people using screen readers and help search engines understand your photos.
cards.recommended_action: Add a short description to each image that shows your work, team or location.
cards.expected_benefit: Your site is easier to use for more people.
